title: Triad tones · all roots
description: Find a root, third or fifth in major, minor and diminished triads.

cards.prompt:
Play the perfect fifth
of C
cards.instruction:
Use the thickest string (low E / string 6).
Use its lowest position on this string (open to fret 11).
cards.hint: The perfect fifth is G2. Press fret 3 on the low E string with your middle finger.
